remarks: There is something special about a home with a view, especially when it comes with the space and flexibility to make everyday living feel effortless. Set within the hillside community of Niguel Summit in Laguna Niguel, this inviting residence pairs beautiful vistas with a thoughtfully arranged floor plan and an enviable position along the Southern California coast. Natural light fills the interiors, where soaring two story ceilings lend an airy sense of scale to the living and dining spaces. A fireplace brings warmth to the room, while the outlook beyond offers a beautiful backdrop for quiet mornings and evenings spent at home.
